userPassword.description: User password. This is the password required to open the encrypted PDF. Fill in at least one of `userPassword` or `ownerPassword`.

ownerPassword.description: Owner password. This is used for permission control and later permission removal. It can control permissions such as printing, copying, editing, commenting, and form filling. Use a value different from `userPassword` when possible.

allowPrint.description: Whether printing is allowed. Enter `true` or `false`. Default: `false`.

allowCopy.description: Whether copying PDF content is allowed. Enter `true` or `false`. Default: `false`.

allowDocumentChanges.description: Whether modifying document content is allowed. Enter `true` or `false`. Default: `false`.

allowDocumentAssembly.description: Whether page assembly is allowed, such as inserting, deleting, rotating, or reordering pages. Enter `true` or `false`. Default: `false`.

allowCommenting.description: Whether adding or editing comments is allowed. Enter `true` or `false`. Default: `false`.

allowFormFieldEntry.description: Whether filling form fields is allowed. Enter `true` or `false`. Default: `false`.
